notes: NLP technical report (mT5 / mC4), not a system card. No safety, alignment, toxicity, bias, or dangerous-capability section or evals. Skipped all capability numbers (XTREME: XNLI, PAWS-X, WikiAnn NER, XQuAD, MLQA, TyDi QA; SQuAD vs T5; ablations). Pre-training used about 1 trillion tokens over 1M steps of length-1024 sequences; no FLOPs given so trainingCompute is not_stated. Length-1024 is a training sequence length, not a stated context window. mC4 filters pages with a “bad words” list; that is a data filter, not a model safety claim. Accidental translation is a multilingual generation bug, not a listed safety topic. Checkpoints covered: google/mt5-small through google/mt5-xxl (seed family google/mt5-base).
